# Contineo API LLM Quick Reference (llms.txt)

> Unofficial REST API for Contineo parent/student portals. Retrieves real-time student profile, course enrollments, attendance records, CIE internal assessment marks, and exam history.

## Base Paths
- API Base: `/api`
- OpenAPI Spec: `/openapi.json`
- Interactive Docs: `/docs`
- Health Checks: `/health`, `/api/health`

## Core Authentication & Parameters
Requests use URL query parameters:
- `usn` (string, required): Student University Seat Number (e.g. `1XX00XX000`)
- `dob` (string, required): Date of birth in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (e.g. `2000-01-01`)
- `portal` (string, optional): Portal variant: `even` (default) or `odd` (`parentsodd`). Auto-detected with fallback when omitted.
- `course` (string, required for course-specific endpoints): Course code from `/api/dashboard` (e.g. `21CS51`)

## Endpoint Summary
1. `GET /api/dashboard?usn={usn}&dob={dob}&portal={even|odd}`
   - Overview: student profile, registered courses, attendance percentages, CIE totals, below-threshold warnings (75%, 85%), active `portal`.
2. `GET /api/attendance?usn={usn}&dob={dob}&course={courseCode}&portal={even|odd}`
   - Course attendance: overall metrics (`totalClasses`, `present`, `absent`, `percentage`) and class records array (`date`, `startTime`, `endTime`, `isPresent`, `status`).
3. `GET /api/cie?usn={usn}&dob={dob}&course={courseCode}&portal={even|odd}`
   - CIE evaluation: components array (test names, obtained/max marks, raw string) and `finalCIE` object with course attendance percentage.
4. `GET /api/exam-history?usn={usn}&dob={dob}&portal={even|odd}`
   - Exam results: `student` object, `degreeStats` (credits required/earned/to-earn, CGPA), and semester list (`semesterName`, `creditsRegistered`, `creditsEarned`, `sgpa`, `cgpa`, `courses` with code, name, credits, GPA, grade).

## Error Standard
- Format: `{"error": "message"}`
- 400 Bad Request: Missing required parameters
- 401 Unauthorized: Invalid credentials or portal down
- 404 Not Found: Course code or detail link not found
- 500 Internal Server Error: Portal scraping or network failure
